title: Monorepo with CI and local compose
story: As an operator, I want one repository with `api`, `web`, `call-worker` and `tools` packages, CI on every push and a docker compose for local work, so that every engineer starts from the same checkout on day one.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a fresh clone, when `docker compose up` runs, then Postgres, the api and the web shell start and the health route answers 200.
Given a push to any branch, when CI runs, then lint, type checks and unit tests run for Python and TypeScript and a failure blocks merge.

title: Core settings, database and migrations
story: As an engineer, I want `forone.core` with typed settings, a Postgres connection, Alembic migrations and the three database roles (`forone_app`, `forone_workflows`, `forone_purge`), so that every service reads configuration and the schema the same way.
acceptance_criteria:
Given an empty database, when `alembic upgrade head` runs, then every table in the architecture's data design exists with row-level security enabled on learner-keyed tables.
Given the `forone_app` role, when it tries to delete from `events`, then the database refuses.

title: API skeleton with OpenAPI codegen
story: As an engineer, I want a FastAPI `api` service with versioned routes under `/v1`, request ids, and an OpenAPI schema the web client generates types from, so that client and server never disagree on a payload.
acceptance_criteria: Given a route is added to `api`, when CI runs, then the generated TypeScript client is regenerated and a stale client fails the build.

title: Durable workflows on Inngest
story: As an engineer, I want Inngest wired with a hello function, event-driven triggers and retries, so that every multi-step job (produce an episode, after-session pass, deletion) is durable and resumable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a function step throws, when Inngest retries, then completed steps are not re-run and the failure is visible in the Inngest dashboard with the learner id tokenized.

title: Staging infrastructure as code
story: As an operator, I want Terraform for staging (VPC with NAT and endpoints, RDS Postgres 16 Multi-AZ-ready with pgvector, S3 with KMS, ECR, ECS Fargate, ALB with WAF, Secrets Manager) written as a module production reuses, so that production is the same code applied twice.
acceptance_criteria:
Given `terraform apply` on staging, when it completes, then the api answers on the staging hostname over TLS and the call-worker task definition exists.
Given the home region is not yet confirmed by counsel, when staging is created, then the region is a single variable and nothing else in the module names it.
depends_on: E01-S01; legal view on region (blocking item B4) for production only

title: Error tracking and tracing wired
story: As an operator, I want Sentry in every service and Langfuse wired for model calls under the agreed retention, so that a failure is seen with context and no learner text leaks into a third party unscrubbed.
acceptance_criteria:
Given an exception in `api`, `web` or `call-worker`, when it is raised, then it appears in Sentry with the learner id tokenized and no transcript text.
Given a test user in Langfuse, when per-user deletion is called, then every trace for that user is gone within the documented window (verified once in W1).

title: Staging deploy pipeline and canary episode
story: As an operator, I want a merge to `main` to deploy to staging and run a canary episode for a synthetic learner, so that a broken build is known within minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a merge to `main`, when the pipeline finishes, then staging runs the new build and the canary produces one episode end to end or pages.

title: Media storage, per-learner keys and the media route
story: As a learner, I want my audio stored under a key that is mine alone and served only to me, so that nobody else can read my episodes or my voice.
acceptance_criteria:
Given an episode is published, when its segments are written to S3, then each object is encrypted with a per-learner data key (SSE-C) derived under KMS and the bucket policy denies unencrypted writes.
Given a signed media request from another learner's session, when it hits the media route, then it is refused with 403 and audited.
Given the drop minute for 50 learners, when a load test runs, then p95 first byte for a segment is under 500 ms.

title: Production stood up and restored once
story: As an operator, I want production applied from the same Terraform in Multi-AZ, with a documented restore drill from backup, so that the beta runs on an environment we have already brought back from the dead.
acceptance_criteria:
Given production exists, when the restore drill runs on a copy, then a point-in-time restore completes and the privacy checks pass on the restored copy.
Given the freeze on 19 December 12:00, when anything is deployed after it, then it is a hotfix with a named approver in the release manifest.

epic: Vendor tests and the language gate
title: Consent addendum before any clip leaves
story: As an operator, I want every Milestone 0 learner whose clips are used in vendor tests to have accepted an addendum naming the vendors, so that the tests do not break the promise the pilot made.
acceptance_criteria: Given a clip in the test set, when the vendor-lab CLI runs, then it refuses any clip whose learner has no addendum on file and any vendor whose register row is `blocked`.

epic: Vendor tests and the language gate
title: Recognizer test on 30 learner clips
story: As an operator, I want the 30 clips run through Soniox, Deepgram, AssemblyAI and ElevenLabs Scribe with the hand tags, so that the streaming and verbatim vendors are chosen on whether they keep learner errors.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a clip with tagged errors, when each vendor transcribes it, then the sheet records, per vendor, the share of tagged errors kept verbatim, the share of own-language words caught, and latency.
Given the sheet, when a vendor keeps fewer than 90% of tagged errors, then it cannot be the verbatim vendor for English.

epic: Vendor tests and the language gate
title: Blind two-host voice test
story: As an operator, I want the same two-host script and the Salma script rendered on Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS, Inworld TTS-2 and ElevenLabs v4 and rated blind by 10 listeners as episode voice and call voice together, so that the voice vendor is the one people would listen to.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the playlists, when 10 raters finish, then the decision CLI outputs a winner and a runner-up per language with the rating spread.
Given the winner, when its streaming first-byte latency is measured, then it is under 300 ms or the runner-up carries the call voice.

epic: Vendor tests and the language gate
title: Fifty scripted calls for latency
story: As an operator, I want 50 scripted calls from Milestone 0 audio run against the minimal call-worker in both worker placements, so that the host's reply latency is measured before any learner calls.
acceptance_criteria: Given the 50 calls, when `tools/call-bench` finishes, then `reply_latency_ms` median is under 1,500 and p95 under 2,500, and `silence_to_sound_ms` is recorded per vendor pair.

epic: Vendor tests and the language gate
title: Vendors frozen and adapters for the winners only
story: As an engineer, I want `vendors.yaml` committed with the winners by 27 November and thin adapters (`llm`, `tts`, `asr`, `align`, `embed`) only for the winning and secondary vendors, so that nothing in week 3 is built on an untested vendor.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a role, when code requests a vendor, then it goes through the adapter and the tracing middleware, never a vendor SDK directly (a lint rule fails otherwise).
Given the primary voice vendor's key is revoked for an hour, when production runs, then the secondary carries the same day's production.

epic: Vendor tests and the language gate
title: English language package v1
story: As a teacher role, I want an English package with word frequency ranks, a lemmatizer, a chunk list of about 300 formulaic sequences, the structure inventory (about 120 structures at W1, a few hundred by W3, from the English Grammar Profile), a ban list of stock names and tropes, and name rules, so that coverage, targeting and classification run on real data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the 10 hand-checked pilot scripts, when the coverage check runs, then its known-word percentage matches the pilot checker within 0.5 points.

epic: Vendor tests and the language gate
title: Host and Salma bibles in the package
story: As a writer role, I want the host bibles (Karim, Mona, the default world) and Salma's strings versioned inside the language package, so that a prompt change is a release and the characters stay written by people.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bible change, when it is merged, then the release manifest records the version and the eval gate runs the writer and host suites.
depends_on: E02-S06; who writes the hosts and Salma (blocking item B3)

epic: Vendor tests and the language gate
title: The language gate as a runnable harness
story: As an operator, I want the five gate checks (blind voice rating, 30-clip recognizer test, native read of 10 scripts, call latency, structure inventory present) as jobs with a one-page result per language, so that a new language opens by passing a test, not by a vendor's list.
acceptance_criteria: Given a candidate language, when the harness runs with its clips, raters and scripts, then it outputs pass or fail per check and refuses to mark the package shippable unless all five pass.

epic: Vendor tests and the language gate
title: Second-language dry run through the gate
story: As an operator, I want one large candidate language (for example Spanish) run through the harness during the beta, so that we know how long a language takes and what breaks before the public launch.
acceptance_criteria: Given the dry run, when it finishes, then a report lists each check's result, the cost, the days taken and the native-speaker time used.

title: Append-only events with idempotent append
story: As an engineer, I want an `events` table partitioned by month with RLS, a typed payload registry and `events.append` with idempotency keys and clock-skew handling, so that the whole learner model can be rebuilt from the log.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the same event sent twice with one idempotency key, when appended, then exactly one row exists.
Given a client timestamp 3 hours in the future, when appended, then the server time is stored and the skew recorded.

title: Word bank with spaced scheduling
story: As a teacher role, I want a per-word bank with known-word probability, priors from frequency and the word check, and an FSRS-style scheduler per word, structure and corrected form, so that the language comes back when it is about to be forgotten.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a word with predicted recall below 0.85 by the next drop time, when `due_list` runs, then the word is due.
Given the pilot learner files' hand-kept "next due" column, when `due_list` is compared, then 80% of items agree.

title: Structure map and error profile
story: As a teacher role, I want a structure map with 14-day accuracy windows and an error profile where an error (not a slip) needs 3 observations across 2 sessions, so that the hosts bring back the right forms of real mistakes, not one-off slips.
acceptance_criteria: Given two observations of the same error in one session, when the updater runs, then it is still a slip; a third in a later session makes it an error with a `working_on` candidate.

title: Life facts with the learner's exact words
story: As a learner, I want every fact the show knows about me stored with the sentence I said, a confidence, a sensitivity class and an expiry, so that the show only uses what I told it.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a proposed fact without a verbatim quote found in the transcript, when `verify_quote` runs, then the fact stays `heard_once` and never reaches a brief.
Given a fact in a sensitive class (health, money, relationships, religion, politics), when the learner did not raise it themselves, then it is never stored.
Given the confirmed facts in the pilot learner files, when replayed against the imported transcripts, then 100% pass the quote check.

title: Interests, goals, show canon and the series bible
story: As a writer role, I want interests with decay, the season goal in the learner's words, show canon (side characters capped at 3 to 5, places, running jokes) and a series bible excerpt, so that the show stays one show.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sixth side character proposed, when the canon write runs, then it is refused and the writer is told to reuse one.

title: Compiled briefs per role
story: As a role, I want `briefs.compile(role)` for teacher, writer, host, Salma, chat and proof returning only what that role needs, with confirmed facts only, so that no role ever sees the whole file.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a host brief, when compiled, then it holds the call plan, the recall gaps, the due words, the forms to echo, and at most 2 confirmed life facts, and fits the cached prompt budget.
Given an unconfirmed fact, when any brief is compiled, then it is absent.

title: Onboarding writes and word-check scoring
story: As a learner, I want my intake cards, word-check answers and consents to seed my model, so that my first episode is pitched at my level.
acceptance_criteria:
Given 48 word-check answers (36 real, 12 pseudowords), when scored, then the band estimate matches the pilot kit's method and pseudoword hits lower the confidence.
Given the 15 pilot word checks, when rescored, then every estimate reproduces the kit's number.

title: Player, article, chat and call event ingestion
story: As a teacher role, I want play, huh, tap, keep, article scroll, followed-answer, chat and call-turn events ingested end to end from the web app and the worker, so that the model sees what the learner actually did.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a learner taps a word twice, when events arrive, then the word becomes a recall candidate.
Given an api outage of 5 minutes, when the client queue retries, then no event is lost or duplicated.

title: Apply the after-session result
story: As a teacher role, I want `apply_after_pass` to update words, structures, errors, skills, interests, facts, canon, the scheduler and the notebook counts in one transaction, so that the next plan reads a consistent model.
acceptance_criteria: Given one pilot learner's 14 imported sessions, when the full after-pass replays, then the word bank's owned words and the pattern errors agree with Muath's hand-kept file on 80% of items.

title: Learner edits: veto, add, fix a memory
story: As a learner, I want to veto or add a "working on" item, correct or delete a fact, and flag a wrong memory, so that I steer the teacher and a wrong memory is fixed at once.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a veto, when saved, then the teacher is re-triggered the same day and the next plan no longer targets the item.
Given a fact deleted, when any later brief compiles, then the fact is absent and a `facts.invalidated` event exists.
Given a `wrong_memory_flag`, when raised, then it counts toward the wrong-memory metric (target under 1 in 100 callbacks).

title: Export, purge order and rebuild
story: As a learner, I want an export of everything about me and a deletion that purges in a known order, so that the data is mine.
acceptance_criteria:
Given an export request, when the job runs, then every JSON opens, transcripts are included, and the link is emailed within 1 hour.
Given a deletion, when the purge runs, then the `deletion_ledger` lists every store in order and `privacy/verify` passes.
Given a code-version bump, when `learner/rebuild` replays the log, then the diff is reported as a count.

title: Teacher plans the session
story: As a learner, I want an unseen teacher to pick one grammar target, 2 to 4 words by need and readiness, the right forms of my own mistakes to bring back, and three ideas for tomorrow, so that every episode teaches without looking like a lesson.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a compiled teacher brief, when the teacher runs, then `validate_plan` passes: exactly 1 grammar target, 2 to 4 words, no target used 4 sessions in a row, at least 80% of new words from the top 3,000 lemmas.
Given an error in the profile, when the plan is made, then the right form appears in the plan's "bring back" list with a count of natural uses.

title: Writer produces the package
story: As a learner, I want a script of 2 to 4 scenes with a 30-second cold open that calls back yesterday's words, an article at my level, a call brief with planned host moves, and a chat opener, so that the four doors tell one story.
acceptance_criteria: Given a plan, when the writer runs, then `validate_package` passes: scenes 2 to 4, cold open at most 30 s, at most 2 life facts, target words present in the dialogue, the ending is a question to the learner by name.

title: Fitter: coverage in code with targeted rewrites
story: As a learner, I want about 95% of the episode's words to be ones I know (98% for text), so that I follow it without a dictionary.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a script below the coverage dial, when the fitter runs, then only the failing sentences go back for a rewrite, at most 2 rounds, and the result is logged with the new-word count (3 to 6).
Given the first three episodes of a learner, when fitted, then the dial is one step easier.

title: Editor from a second vendor
story: As a learner, I want every episode checked for correctness, no uncertain memory, the fun carrying the language, nothing that reads as a lesson or a correction, variety, the laws, and "would they pick this over a real podcast?", so that a bad episode never ships.
acceptance_criteria:
Given an editor fail, when repair runs, then one targeted repair and one recheck happen; a second fail ships the fallback episode and a human is paged after 3 fallbacks in 7 days.
Given the Milestone 0 packages and Muath's reads, when the editor runs over them, then agreement with his step-8 reads is above 80%.

title: Voice studio with re-listen
story: As a learner, I want two distinct host voices, word timings, correctly pronounced names, and a mix within 4:00 to 8:00, so that the show sounds like a show.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a script, when rendered scene-parallel, then `check_duration` passes, timings align to words, and every line passes the re-listen check within 2 re-synthesis attempts.
Given the primary voice vendor fails, when production runs, then the secondary voice renders the same script that day.

title: Senses, glosses and publish
story: As a learner, I want a meaning in my own language under any hard word and the episode published atomically, so that "Huh?" always has something to show.
acceptance_criteria: Given a package, when published, then uploads finish before the transaction commits, `episodes.cost_usd` is set, and the gloss bundle is shared across learners for the same sense.

title: Batch mode with the on-demand fallback
story: As an operator, I want everything nobody waits on submitted in pooled batches with `batch/watch`, and an on-demand fallback at drop time minus 90 minutes, so that cost is low and no drop is missed.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a batch not returned 90 minutes before a learner's drop, when the watcher checks, then the episode is produced on-demand and the batch result is discarded.
Given 20 test episodes, when produced in batch, then cost per episode and cache hit rate per step are in the cost report.

title: On-demand kinds: pilot, sample, swap, return, recap
story: As a learner, I want the pilot and sample to start playing within 30 to 45 seconds and a swap or return episode within 30 seconds, so that the first ten minutes and a bad day never wait on a batch.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the pilot kind, when scene 1 passes its gate, then streaming starts while scenes 2 and 3 render.
Given the sample kind, when produced, then cost is under $0.05 and moderation runs on the input.
Given the return kind after 5+ days away, when produced, then it is one step easier, opens from the learner's life and never mentions the days missed.

title: Ideas, the cutoff and "why this episode"
story: As a learner, I want three ideas each night (one from my life, one wildcard, at most one arc), a 6-hour cutoff before my drop, and 2 to 4 reasons for the episode I got, so that I own the topic and can see the teacher's reasons.
acceptance_criteria:
Given no pick by the cutoff, when production starts, then the top-ranked idea is used and shown as the hero.
Given an episode, when "why this episode" is opened, then 2 to 4 reasons appear, each tied to a plan element.

title: Casting: hello clips, voice swap, name respelling
story: As a learner, I want to hear each host say hello, swap a voice, pick an accent and have my name said right, so that the show sounds like mine.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a casting change after the pilot is made, when saved, then the pilot re-renders with the new voice version.
Given the 15 pilot intake names, when respelled, then every name passes Muath's listen check.

title: The variety system
story: As a learner, I want no format three times in a row, no stock names or tropes, and no episode too like my last 20, so that the show never goes stale.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new script, when its cosine similarity to any of the last 20 exceeds the threshold set from the pilot's "too alike" pairs, then the writer is re-run with a variety note.

title: Arcs, seasons and the series bible writes
story: As a learner, I want arcs of 1 to 3 weeks, at most 2 open, that advance only when I show up, inside a 4-week season with a goal in my words, so that the story waits for me and never becomes a debt.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a learner away for 10 days, when they return, then arc state is unchanged and the return episode picks up the open arc or none.
Given a third arc proposed, when the teacher plans, then it is refused.

title: Fallback episode, human page and review sampling
story: As an operator, I want a fallback episode kind, a page listing failed runs, and 10 random episodes per learner per month queued for a human read, so that a bad night is survivable and quality is checked by a person.
acceptance_criteria: Given a run fails after repair, when the fallback ships, then the failed package is on the human page with the editor's reasons.

title: Minimal call-worker on staging
story: As an engineer, I want a `call-worker` on LiveKit Agents with Silero VAD, the multilingual turn detector, the two STT plugins in play, the Anthropic LLM plugin and the two TTS plugins, serving a hand-written call bundle, so that the 50 calls and the onboarding calls run on real vendors by week 2.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a call request, when the worker joins the room, then the host speaks an opening line within 3 s of connect.
Given drain mode, when a deploy happens, then live calls finish before the task stops.

title: Host prompt with the governor
story: As a learner, I want a host who answers my mistake with the right form in a friendly echo and carries on, asks "sorry, you what?" only when meaning is lost, and never says I was wrong, so that teaching stays invisible.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a learner turn with an error, when the host replies, then at most 1 recast is present, phrased as a question or continuation, and no string from the law corpus ("wrong", "the correct answer", "you should say") appears.
Given the per-call budgets (3 clarification requests, 1 nudge, 2 to 4 recall gaps, 1 retell, 1 task remark), when the governor sees a reply over budget, then it re-requests with the `@moves` header and the violation is counted.
Given the Milestone 0 transcripts, when replayed through the governor, then zero violations before any live call.

title: Per-turn audio upload and verbatim re-transcription
story: As a teacher role, I want each learner turn uploaded under the learner's key and re-transcribed verbatim with disfluencies after the turn, so that the analyst sees what was actually said, not what the streaming recognizer smoothed.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a turn ends, when `call.turn_audio_ready` fires, then `call/verbatim-turn` appends `call_turn_verbatim` with a confidence and `low_confidence_reason` from the package threshold.
Given voice storage is off, when the call ends, then every turn's audio is deleted within 15 minutes and only the verbatim text remains.

title: Salma as the onboarding voice
story: As a learner, I want Salma to talk with me in my own language for about 3 minutes, at most 8 turns, with each fact she hears shown as a card, so that the show knows me before it starts.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the intake, when Salma asks a question twice without an answer, then she skips it.
Given two lines in the target language, when I answer, then the answers feed the level estimate and nothing is corrected.

title: The first call
story: As a learner, I want a 60 to 90 second first call with no recasts and no nudges, ending with one specific thing I managed, so that the first call is a win, not a test.
acceptance_criteria: Given kind `first`, when the call runs, then the governor budget is zero recasts, zero nudges, and the close names one task-level thing done.

title: Hold-to-talk and adaptive patience
story: As a learner, I want to hold one button to keep the floor while I search for a word, and a host whose silence threshold adapts to how I pause, so that nobody interrupts me mid-sentence.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the button is held, when I pause 5 s, then the host does not speak.
Given the pause profile, when a call starts, then end-of-turn silence starts at 1.5 s and adapts within 1.0 to 2.5 s; backchannels play once per pause over 1.2 s.

title: The word button
story: As a learner, I want to say a word in my own language and have the host give it back in the language I am learning and keep going, so that a missing word never ends the conversation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a word in the learner's language, when the button is used, then the target word is spoken within 2 s and the conversation continues; if the word was produced before, a hint comes first.

title: Recall gaps, the retell and the call brief moves
story: As a learner, I want the host to leave 2 to 4 gaps for words from last week and ask once for a 60 to 90 second retell, so that I pull language out of memory and speak for 4+ minutes.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a call brief with planned moves, when the call runs, then each move is attempted once and logged with whether the learner produced the target.
Given the host's talk share, when measured per call, then it is at most 40%.

title: Anxiety mode, silence offers, timers and goodbyes
story: As a learner, I want the host to get gentler and simpler when I freeze, to offer a smaller question after 8 s of silence, and to close naturally around 6:30 and never after 8:00, so that a call ends like a conversation.
acceptance_criteria:
Given median turn under 4 words in the first 2 minutes, or two 8 s silences, or the last call abandoned, when detected, then anxiety mode sets recall gaps to at most 1 and the host simplifies.
Given 8:00, when reached, then the host says goodbye within one turn; no homework string appears.

title: Voice-note fallback and resume after drop
story: As a learner, I want a bad connection to turn the call into voice notes with the same host, and a dropped call to resume where it was, so that no session is lost.
acceptance_criteria: Given two reconnect failures, when the client falls back, then a voice note to the host gets a voiced reply within 30 s and the session counts fully.

title: Crisis step-out and AI disclosure in the call
story: As a learner, I want the host to say it is an AI whenever I ask, and to step out of character and give real resources if I say something that suggests I am in danger, so that the show is honest and safe.
acceptance_criteria:
Given "are you a real person?", when asked in any language, then the host answers plainly that it is an AI.
Given a keyword-list hit, when detected, then the host steps out, the resources card is sent, the call audio is quarantined, and a `crisis.activated` event exists.

title: Pronunciation on "say it once" and the recordings route
story: As a learner, I want to say one known sentence after the hosts and have it scored only internally, and to record the then-and-now and small-door notes through the same path, so that being understood is measured without a number on screen.
acceptance_criteria: Given a say-it-once clip, when scored, then the score is stored in the model and no client payload carries it.

title: Round two and the dial-in experiment
story: As a learner, I want the same argument again, shorter and faster, and the option to join by phone on a commute, so that I speak more on the days I can.
acceptance_criteria:
Given kind `round_two`, when offered from Today, then it lasts 2 to 3 minutes, once per episode, on every plan.
Given a dial-in call, when it runs, then audio is flagged `low_confidence`, no talkback is offered and no claim is built from it.

title: Sample episode and landing page
story: As a visitor, I want a free 90-second sample about something I type, playable within 30 seconds, so that I hear the product before signing up.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a topic, when submitted with a Turnstile pass, then a streamed sample starts under 30 s, costs under $0.05, and the same device or email cannot request another for 24 hours.
Given a sample, when shared, then the share page plays it and shows where the signup is.

title: Waitlist and invites
story: As an operator, I want a waitlist loaded from the Milestone 0 sign-ups and invite batches of about 50 a week, so that the beta opens in cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invite code, when redeemed, then onboarding starts; an unredeemed or used code shows the waitlist.

title: A1: sound within a minute
story: As a learner, I want one screen, one tap and an age checkbox, then Salma's voice in my own language, so that I hear the product before I read about it.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a first open, when the tap happens, then Salma's first clip plays within 60 s on a 4G phone and the screen's text is in the learner's language with right-to-left handled.
Given the age box unticked or under 18, when continuing, then the flow stops with a plain message and nothing is stored.

title: A3: three minutes with Salma, with fact cards
story: As a learner, I want to talk or type with Salma for about 3 minutes and see each fact she heard as a card I can fix or delete, so that the show starts from what I said, not what it guessed.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a card, when I edit or delete it, then the stored fact changes before the pilot is written.
Given the typed path, when the call cannot connect, then the same questions run as text with no loss.

title: A4: the optional word check
story: As a learner, I want an optional 60-second "tap the words you know" with Skip as big as Start, so that the show pitches at my level without a test.
acceptance_criteria:
Given 48 items, when 75 s pass, then the check stops and scores what was answered.
Given Skip, when tapped, then the level comes from Salma's two target-language lines and the band prior.

title: A5: casting while the pilot is made
story: As a learner, I want to hear each host say hello, swap a voice and pick an accent during the 40 to 90 seconds the pilot takes, so that the wait is the cast.
acceptance_criteria: Given the pilot is still rendering, when casting ends early, then the screen shows the hosts talking about the topic, never a spinner or a percentage.

title: A6 and A7: the pilot and the first call
story: As a learner, I want a 2 to 3 minute pilot about my topic, then a 60 to 90 second first call, with Mona telling me once about the word button, so that I speak in the first five minutes.
acceptance_criteria:
Given intake completed, when the pilot is requested, then playback starts within 45 s.
Given the pilot ends, when Karim throws a question, then the first call connects within 3 s and runs with no recasts.

title: A8 and A9: one win, then the account
story: As a learner, I want to hear one specific thing I managed, then make the account with an email code, pick my drop time in life terms and answer voice-storage consent in one plain sentence, so that I decide after I have heard myself.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the account step, when completed, then the pre-account learner id is re-keyed, the 7-day trial starts on 2 a day, and no card is asked.
Given consent declined, when saved, then call audio is analysed and deleted within 15 minutes from then on.

title: A10: install card and the feed handoff
story: As a learner, I want an install card and a one-tap link that puts my private feed in my podcast app, so that tomorrow's episode arrives where I already listen.
acceptance_criteria: Given the handoff, when tapped on iOS and Android, then the feed subscribes in the chosen app and the installed app signs in without a second email code.

title: Apple and Google sign-in
story: As a learner, I want to sign in with Apple or Google, so that I do not need an email code every time.
acceptance_criteria: Given the developer accounts are approved, when sign-in runs, then the Apple relay email is accepted as the account email.

title: Re-onboard the Milestone 0 learners
story: As an operator, I want the 15 pilot learners to go through A1 to A10 on production under the beta consent, with their pilot recordings as the "then" baseline where they consented, so that the exit numbers come from real people.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pilot learner, when re-onboarded, then first sound, pilot time and first spoken sentence are measured and their imported model is linked to the new account.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: Web shell: PWA, bidi, tokens, law lint
story: As a learner, I want an app that installs, reads right in my language's direction, and has no counter, streak, chart or percent component anywhere, so that the laws are enforced by the build.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a component named or rendering a streak, level, percentage or chart, when lint runs, then the build fails.
Given Arabic interface text quoting English, when rendered, then the bidi snapshot suite passes.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: Email-code auth and sessions
story: As a learner, I want to sign in with a code sent to my email and stay signed in on my phone, so that there is no password to forget.
acceptance_criteria: Given a code, when used twice or after 10 minutes, then it is refused.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: The player
story: As a learner, I want audio first with the transcript folded, a replay-line button, "Huh?" that replays the last sentence at 0.85x with meanings under hard words, speeds of 0.75, 0.85 and 1.0, and tap any word to hear and keep it, so that I can follow at the edge of what I understand.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a dropped episode, when Play is tapped, then sound starts under 2 s from cache or network fallback.
Given "Huh?", when tapped, then the previous sentence replays slower and the gloss appears; the event is logged.
Given the phone locks, when playing, then Media Session keeps playback and lock-screen controls on iOS 17 and 18 and Android 13 and 14.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: Event queue to the api
story: As a teacher role, I want every play, huh, tap, keep and scroll event queued on the device and sent in order, so that the model sees the session even on a bad connection.
acceptance_criteria: Given an api outage, when events accumulate, then they are sent in order when the api returns with no duplicates.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: Today in every state
story: As a learner, I want Today to show one thing: my episode, with the four doors, "why this episode?", and the small door, in the right state (dropped, played, skipped yesterday, return, trial ended), so that opening the app means pressing play.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a skipped day, when Today opens, then nothing new is shown, nothing piles up, and no reminder was sent.
Given the return state, when Today opens, then the return episode is the hero and the days missed are never mentioned.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: Read: the article with read-along audio
story: As a learner, I want the article that arms me for the call, at my level, with audio to read along, so that reading and listening happen together.
acceptance_criteria: Given the article, when opened, then the word sheet opens under 300 ms on tap and the scroll depth is logged.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: The call screen
story: As a learner, I want a call screen with the host's orb, sentence captions, hold-to-talk, the word button, a planning card for 30 seconds before the call and the voice-note fallback, so that the call works with earphones on a bus.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the call connects, when captions arrive on the data channel, then they show per sentence with the recast word in bold and no correction mark.
Given the feed-to-call handoff, when measured, then the time from tapping the push to the host's first line is logged.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: Chat and choosing tomorrow
story: As a learner, I want a short chat with the host (3 to 5 messages) that ends with three ideas for tomorrow and "tell Salma an idea", so that I choose tonight and have nothing to decide in the morning.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the fifth host message, when sent, then the thread closes with the three ideas and a clean goodbye.
Given "why do we say it like that?", when asked, then the host explains, because the learner asked, and no explanation appears otherwise.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: One swap a day
story: As a learner, I want to swap the dropped episode for another idea once a day, so that a dud never costs me the day.
acceptance_criteria: Given a swap, when requested, then the new episode streams under 30 s and a second swap is not offered.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: The small door
story: As a learner, I want a 90-second recap and one voice note up to 60 s on a bad day, so that a bad day still counts fully.
acceptance_criteria: Given the small door used, when the day closes, then it counts as an active day and the next episode is made.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: Show shelf and the episode page
story: As a learner, I want every past episode reachable and replayable without limit, so that listening to what exists is free on every plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Show tab, when opened, then episodes list newest first with no count, no completion marks and no progress bar.

epic: The daily loop in the web app
title: Accessibility, performance and the device matrix
story: As a learner on a mid-range Android, I want the app to be fast and usable with a screen reader, so that the product is not only for new iPhones.
acceptance_criteria:
Given Lighthouse on a mid-range Android, when run, then performance is above 85 and the bundle is under the budget.
Given the week-3 device matrix, when run, then background play, push and install pass on iOS 17 and 18 and Android 13 and 14 Chrome.

epic: Private feed, drop and the one cue
title: A private podcast feed per learner
story: As a learner, I want a private RSS feed with my episodes, so that I can listen in Apple Podcasts or any podcast app with the phone locked.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the feed token, when fetched by Apple Podcasts, Pocket Casts and one Android app, then the episode plays with the enclosure streamed and the fetch logged in `feed_fetches`.
Given a reset of the token, when done from controls, then the old link stops working at once.

epic: Private feed, drop and the one cue
title: Drop scheduling and the day's rule
story: As a learner, I want my episode ready before the time I chose, in my local time, and nothing made after a day I skipped, so that nothing piles up.
acceptance_criteria:
Given an active day (half an episode played, a call started or the small door used), when the night runs, then tomorrow's episode is produced; otherwise nothing is.
Given the drop minute, when 95% of the week's drops are checked, then they were ready before drop time.

epic: Private feed, drop and the one cue
title: Web push for the drop only
story: As a learner, I want one notification when the episode drops, and no other, so that the cue is mine.
acceptance_criteria: Given the push subscription, when the episode drops, then one push arrives; a test fails if any code path sends a push for another reason.

epic: Private feed, drop and the one cue
title: Salma's 5-second feed tag
story: As a learner, I want a 5-second tag from Salma in my own language at the start of each feed episode, so that the feed episode feels like mine.
acceptance_criteria: Given a published episode, when the feed item is built, then the tag is prepended and the timings shift accordingly.

epic: Private feed, drop and the one cue
title: The one opt-in gap note
story: As a learner, I want to write one note to myself at signup that is sent once after a gap I chose (7, 10 or 14 days), so that the only reminder is in my own words.
acceptance_criteria: Given the gap, when reached, then the note is sent exactly once and never again; with no opt-in, nothing is sent.

epic: Private feed, drop and the one cue
title: Return episode after a gap
story: As a learner, I want the first session after 5+ days to be a return episode, one step easier, opening from my life, so that coming back is easy and never guilty.
acceptance_criteria: Given 5 days without a session, when the learner opens the app or the feed, then the return kind is produced on demand within 30 s.

epic: Private feed, drop and the one cue
title: Rhythm in words and re-anchoring
story: As a learner, I want my rhythm ("4 days, 2 spare") mentioned only in words by the hosts, and a re-anchoring offer when life has moved my cue, so that there is no counter and no guilt.
acceptance_criteria: Given no session within 3 hours of the anchor for two weeks, when detected, then Salma offers once to change the drop time, in the app only.

title: Verbatim recognizer and the confidence threshold
story: As an analyst role, I want a `VerbatimRecognizer` on the chosen vendor with disfluencies kept and a per-language confidence threshold from the 30-clip test, so that the learner's errors survive transcription.
acceptance_criteria: Given the 30 pilot clips, when run, then `low_confidence_reason` is set correctly against the package threshold and the error-survival rate is recorded as the baseline.

title: Structure rules and the edit classifier
story: As an analyst role, I want `structure_rules.yaml` and an `edit_classifier` that turns minimal edits into structure-inventory tags by rules (errant plus spaCy), so that errors are classified the same way every time.
acceptance_criteria: Given Muath's pilot tags, when the classifier runs on the same calls, then precision is at least 0.8 on the claim-feeding tags, or those tags are marked not claim-eligible.

title: Measures from timings
story: As an analyst role, I want fluency measures (speech rate, pause length, mean length of run, words used and understood) computed from verbatim word timings, so that claims have numbers with known noise.
acceptance_criteria: Given the pilot week-0 and week-3 recordings, when measures run, then the standard error per metric is computed from the test-retest pairs.

title: The analyst with a fixed schema
story: As a teacher role, I want an analyst that reads the verbatim call and the session events and outputs a fixed schema (errors, words produced, recall gaps hit, retell measures, talk share), validated by code, so that the model is updated from checked data.
acceptance_criteria: Given output that fails the schema, when validated, then the pass retries once and then marks the session degraded, never writing partial data.

title: The memory keeper
story: As a learner, I want life facts proposed only with my exact quote, a confidence ladder (heard once, repeated, confirmed) and a shelf life, so that a wrong memory is rare and fixable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the pilot intakes and calls replayed, when compared with the hand-confirmed facts, then fact precision is above 0.9 and the false-fact rate below 1 in 100.

title: The after-session pass end to end
story: As a teacher role, I want `session/after-pass` to run verbatim, analyst, memory keeper, updater, session summary and the teacher trigger within 10 minutes of a session, so that tomorrow's plan uses today's call.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a session ends, when the pass runs, then `session.after_pass.completed` fires under 10 minutes p99 and the teacher is triggered once (triggers coalesce).
Given each pilot learner's 14 days replayed, when compared with the learner files' structures tables, then the structure map agrees on 80% of items.

title: Skills with ranges and "where do I stand"
story: As a learner, I want separate listening, speaking, reading and writing estimates with ranges, said honestly only when I ask and only for calibrated skills, so that I get a real answer and never a number pushed at me.
acceptance_criteria: Given an uncalibrated skill, when asked, then Salma says it is too early to say, with what would make it possible.

title: Calibration samples and `calibration/run`
story: As an operator, I want Muath's pilot tags imported as calibration samples and a CI job that reports classifier precision and rater agreement (quadratic weighted kappa about 0.7), so that the internal measure is checked against a person.
acceptance_criteria: Given a prompt or rule change, when CI runs, then calibration numbers are compared with the baseline and a drop beyond the threshold fails the build.

title: The recording rater
story: As an operator, I want then-and-now recordings rated by code metrics plus a calibrated model, per language, so that the 4-weekly comparison is like for like.
acceptance_criteria: Given a recording pair, when rated, then accuracy, fluency and complexity measures and a rater judgment are stored with the metric's standard error.

title: Wrong-memory correction path
story: As a learner, I want a wrong fact fixed at once from the notebook and never used again, so that a wrong memory is treated as a bug.
acceptance_criteria: Given `memory/correct`, when called, then `facts.invalidated` is appended, the brief cache for the learner is cleared and the metric increments.

epic: Notebook, controls and Salma on demand
title: Notebook: what I'm working on
story: As a learner, I want to see at most 3 things the teacher is working on with me, each with one of my own sentences, so that I know what the show is doing and can steer it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the list, when shown, then each item has the learner's sentence and no "correct" version beside it.

epic: Notebook, controls and Salma on demand
title: Veto and add
story: As a learner, I want to veto an item or add my own, so that the teacher works on what I want.
acceptance_criteria: Given a veto or add, when saved, then the next day's episode reflects it (synchronous re-target) and the item never returns unless re-added.

epic: Notebook, controls and Salma on demand
title: Words you own
story: As a learner, I want the words I now use, each in a sentence I actually said with the audio, so that I can hear my own competence.
acceptance_criteria: Given a word marked owned (correct, unprompted, a day later, in another session), when listed, then the sentence and clip are the learner's own, with the date.

epic: Notebook, controls and Salma on demand
title: About you: facts with their source
story: As a learner, I want every fact the show knows with when I said it, and to edit or delete it, so that deep memory is trusted, not creepy.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fact, when shown, then the source quote and date appear; edit and delete call `memory/correct`.

epic: Notebook, controls and Salma on demand
title: Hours heard, minutes spoken, "why this episode", out in the world
story: As a learner, I want plain counts of hours heard and minutes spoken, the reasons for today's episode, and a place to log a real-world try, so that progress is evidence, not a score.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the counts, when rendered, then they are plain text, monotonic and never a chart or a percentage (law lint).
Given "I had the interview", when logged, then the hosts celebrate it in the next episode above everything else.

epic: Notebook, controls and Salma on demand
title: The controls sheet
story: As a learner, I want one short sheet: drop time, notification, captions, transcript, speed, feed link, voice storage, research opt-in, export, delete, cancel, so that there is no settings maze.
acceptance_criteria: Given a consent switch flipped, when saved, then a `consent_change` event with the text version shown is recorded and the deletion clocks start.

epic: Notebook, controls and Salma on demand
title: Salma explains when asked
story: As a learner, I want to ask Salma "why do we say it like that?" and get an explanation in my own language, only when I ask, so that explanations exist without ever being pushed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a question, when asked in chat, then Salma explains and no explanation, note or nudge appears unasked anywhere else.

epic: Notebook, controls and Salma on demand
title: Life updates and "tell Salma an idea"
story: As a learner, I want to tell Salma something new in my life or an idea for an episode, so that the show keeps up with me.
acceptance_criteria: Given a life update, when saved, then it goes through the memory keeper with a quote and reaches the next plan only once confirmed.

epic: Notebook, controls and Salma on demand
title: The tape
story: As a learner, I want my then-and-now recordings side by side in the notebook, so that I can hear myself improve.
acceptance_criteria: Given two recordings, when played, then they play in sequence with at most two measured differences in plain words, or none if the gate passed nothing.

epic: Weekly proof, claim gate, recordings and seasons
title: The claim gate
story: As an operator, I want a code module that passes a claim only if it is like for like, beyond about twice the metric's standard error, from at least 2 data points, from clean evidence, and openable, so that the product is believed on good weeks because it admits flat ones.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a claim with one data point, when gated, then it fails with the reason stored.
Given any progress sentence template in the codebase, when CI greps, then each resolves to a `claims` row or the build fails.

epic: Weekly proof, claim gate, recordings and seasons
title: Claims storage and "how we know"
story: As a learner, I want to open the evidence behind any claim, so that nothing about my progress is asserted without proof.
acceptance_criteria: Given a shown claim, when "how we know" is tapped, then the clips, dates and measure appear and `mark_claim_shown` is recorded.

epic: Weekly proof, claim gate, recordings and seasons
title: The proof producer
story: As a learner, I want a 2-minute episode from Salma every week with one headline piece of evidence and what comes next, shorter in a slow week, honest in a flat week, so that I hear what I can now do.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a week with no passed claim, when the proof is made, then it says the week was flat and names the one thing the teacher is changing.
Given fewer than 2 sessions, when the proof is made, then it is about 45 s and about what has built up over time.
Given the proof script, when scanned, then it contains no list of mistakes and no string from the law corpus.

epic: Weekly proof, claim gate, recordings and seasons
title: Proof screen and the worth-it question
story: As a learner, I want the proof on my chosen day with "how we know" and one question, "was this week worth your time?", so that the product measures what matters.
acceptance_criteria: Given the proof day, when it arrives, then it is one of the three allowed messages and the worth-it answer is stored as a measure.

epic: Weekly proof, claim gate, recordings and seasons
title: Then-and-now recording
story: As a learner, I want to record about 3 minutes (a retell, an opinion, 8 repeat sentences) after session 2 and every 4 weeks, skippable, with nothing scored on screen, so that I can hear my own voice then and now.
acceptance_criteria: Given the recording screen, when completed, then `recording.completed` is appended, the audio is under the learner's key, and no number is shown.

epic: Weekly proof, claim gate, recordings and seasons
title: Test-retest pairs and metric unlock
story: As an operator, I want each metric to make claims only once 12 test-retest pairs exist for it, so that early claims are cautious, especially in a new language.
acceptance_criteria: Given the gates page, when opened, then it shows per metric and per language how many pairs exist and the date claims unlock.

epic: Weekly proof, claim gate, recordings and seasons
title: Seasons and the goal in the learner's words
story: As a learner, I want a 4-week season with one real goal in my own words, set with Salma, so that there is a near goal without a level.
acceptance_criteria: Given a season starts, when the goal is set, then it appears in the teacher brief and in "why this episode" reasons.

epic: Weekly proof, claim gate, recordings and seasons
title: Mid-season rehearsal
story: As a learner, I want a real-life rehearsal of my actual scene mid-season, so that the show is the gym and life is the game.
acceptance_criteria: Given a rehearsal episode, when produced, then the call brief carries the scene and the host plays the other side.

epic: Weekly proof, claim gate, recordings and seasons
title: The season finale
story: As a learner, I want a finale with both recordings side by side, at most two measured differences in plain words, my real-world attempt, and next season's goal set inside it, so that finishing never becomes a reason to stop.
acceptance_criteria: Given the first session on or after day 28, when it runs, then the finale kind is produced and the next goal is asked for before the goodbye.

epic: Weekly proof, claim gate, recordings and seasons
title: False-claim audit
story: As an operator, I want a monthly sample of shown claims checked by a person against the evidence, so that the false-claim rate is known (target under 5%).
acceptance_criteria: Given the audit page, when a reviewer marks a claim false, then it is retracted from the notebook and the metric updates.

title: Plan catalogue and the recommended plan
story: As a learner, I want three plans shown plainly (1 a day $19.99, 2 a day $29.99 marked Recommended, 3 a day $44.99), with "about $1 a day" and the tutor comparison, so that the choice is honest and easy.
acceptance_criteria: Given the plans page, when rendered, then no countdown, scarcity, pre-ticked upgrade or guilt copy exists (law lint corpus) and the per-episode price is shown.

title: Allowance enforced on the server
story: As an operator, I want new episodes per active day and one swap enforced in `day/next`, with listening, the article, the chat and round two unlimited, so that no plan loses money at full use and no client can bypass it.
acceptance_criteria:
Given a 1-a-day learner, when a second new episode is requested by any route, then it is refused; replays and round two are allowed.
Given a 2 or 3 a day learner, when the day's other ideas are chosen, then they are made on demand the same day.

title: Trial ledger
story: As a learner, I want a 7-day trial on 2 a day with no card, so that I try the real thing before paying.
acceptance_criteria: Given the account is created, when the trial starts, then the ledger records the plan and end date; a second trial for the same email or device is refused.

title: Checkout and subscriptions
story: As a learner, I want to pay by card or Apple Pay through a web checkout, so that I keep the full product after the trial.
acceptance_criteria: Given a checkout, when the processor confirms, then `subscriptions` holds the plan and `payment_events` the verified webhook; a replayed webhook changes nothing.

title: Day-7 and trial-ended states
story: As a learner, I want a clear day-7 choice and, if I do not pay, my archive, notebook, export and delete kept for 90 days, so that nothing is held hostage.
acceptance_criteria: Given the trial ends unpaid, when Today opens, then the archive and notebook remain readable, no new episode is made, and after 90 days one email precedes deletion.

title: Founding members keep their price
story: As a founding member, I want my plan's price locked for as long as I stay subscribed, so that the promise is real.
acceptance_criteria: Given one of the first 100 paying learners, when prices change, then their subscription keeps the original price.

title: One-tap cancel
story: As a learner, I want to cancel in one tap from controls with no retention flow, so that "never manipulate" holds at the exit.
acceptance_criteria: Given cancel, when tapped, then billing stops at period end, access continues to then, and no message other than a receipt is sent.

title: Billing reconcile
story: As an operator, I want a job that reconciles subscriptions with the processor's records and flags mismatches, so that nobody is charged for what they do not have.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mismatch, when found, then it is listed on the admin page with the learner id tokenized.

title: Regional prices
story: As an operator, I want country-level prices once there is data on where learners come from, so that the product is affordable where incomes are lower.
acceptance_criteria: Given a region list, when prices are set, then the price shown and charged match per country.

title: Per-learner keys and audit log
story: As a learner, I want my audio and transcripts encrypted under a key that is mine, with every staff access logged, so that my data cannot be read in bulk.
acceptance_criteria:
Given `forone.core.keys`, when a learner is created, then a data key is minted under KMS and the audit log records every decrypt purpose.
Given the RLS CI test, when run, then no learner-keyed table is readable across learners by the app role.

title: Processor register and counsel requests sent
story: As an operator, I want `docs/ropa.md` listing every vendor with its DPA status and training opt-out, and the six decision requests sent to counsel in week 1, so that nothing is built on a vendor we cannot use.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the register, when a vendor's row is `blocked`, then the adapters refuse it.
Given 22 December, when checked, then every vendor in `vendors.yaml` has a DPA or clickwrap terms recorded and the training opt-out screenshotted.

title: Consent texts with versions and the A9 flow
story: As a learner, I want consent asked in one plain sentence, right after I heard myself, with the exact text version recorded, and switches in controls, so that my consent is informed and reversible.
acceptance_criteria: Given a consent change, when saved, then `consent_change` carries `text_shown_version` and the Milestone 0 wording is never weakened.

title: Age gate and pre-account sweep
story: As an operator, I want under-18s refused at A1 with a plain message and any pre-account data swept, so that the product is adults-only in fact.
acceptance_criteria: Given an under-18 flag, when any api call follows, then it returns `403 under_18` and the pre-account sweep deletes the data within the hour.

title: Voice storage off: delete within 15 minutes
story: As a learner, I want my call audio analysed and deleted within 15 minutes when I decline storage, and all audio gone within 24 hours when I revoke, so that the promise at consent is kept.
acceptance_criteria: Given storage off, when `audio/expire` runs on `media.object_created`, then the object is gone within 15 minutes of call end and `privacy/verify` confirms it.

title: Export and account deletion on the clock
story: As a learner, I want an export link within an hour and deletion that ends access at once, purges live data in 24 hours and backups in 30 days, so that the data is mine to take or destroy.
acceptance_criteria: Given a deletion, when requested, then access ends immediately, the purge order runs, processor deletions (Langfuse, vendors with retention) are called, and `privacy/verify` passes at 24 hours.

title: Research opt-in, anonymize and revoke
story: As a learner, I want my anonymized transcripts used to improve the teacher only if I opt in, off by default, never audio, with revoke honoured, so that data use is my choice.
acceptance_criteria: Given opt-in, when `research/anonymize` runs, then names from `life_facts.people` are replaced and the output is audited; given revoke, then the learner's rows are removed from the research set.

title: Crisis protocol
story: As a learner, I want the host or Salma to step out of character and give real help if I say something that suggests I am in danger, so that the product is safe.
acceptance_criteria: Given a keyword-list hit, when detected in a call or chat, then the crisis path activates, the audio is quarantined, the resources card shows once on Today, and the keyword list's false-positive rate on about 200 pilot calls is recorded.

title: Output guard and the listener-text sanitizer
story: As an operator, I want every prompt that includes learner text to carry the operator rule, a sanitizer on listener text and names, and an output guard that enforces AI disclosure and told-not-inferred, so that an injection in a call cannot steer the host.
acceptance_criteria: Given the 10 injection transcripts, when replayed, then zero disclosures of the brief and zero rule changes; the 30-case set runs in the offline suite (P1).

title: Staff accounts, roles and the review access rules
story: As an operator, I want staff sign-in with owner, engineer and reviewer roles, and reviewers seeing episodes with names tokenized, so that reading episodes for quality does not expose who the learner is.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reviewer, when opening an episode, then learner names are tokens and the access is audited.

title: Privacy verify and the admin privacy page
story: As an operator, I want a job that checks every privacy promise (deletion windows, export times, consent versions, audio expiry) and a page that shows it, so that a missed promise pages before a learner notices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a missed window, when `privacy/verify` runs, then `privacy_promise_missed` pages.

title: Incident runbook and tabletop
story: As an operator, I want a security incident runbook and a 60-minute tabletop run once before the beta, so that the first incident is not the first rehearsal.
acceptance_criteria: Given the tabletop, when done, then the runbook lists the steps, the contacts, the learner-notice template and the processor list, and the gaps found are fixed or ticketed.

title: Price book
story: As an operator, I want `prices.yaml` with every vendor's unit prices, dated, and a `price_book` table, so that a price change is a commit and the January rises are already in the plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vendor call with no price row, when traced, then it is recorded as `unpriced` and alarms.

title: Tracing middleware and `vendor_calls`
story: As an operator, I want every model, voice and speech call to pass through middleware that records unit usage, price, role, learner (tokenized), episode and cache hit, so that cost is a query from the first test render.
acceptance_criteria: Given the vendor tests in W1, when run, then every render is a priced `vendor_calls` row and "cost per 10 minutes of audio" is real before any episode exists.

title: Session cost roll-up and the per-episode line
story: As an operator, I want `cost/rollup` into `session_costs` per role and vendor, feeding `episodes.cost_usd`, so that the cost report shows where the money goes.
acceptance_criteria: Given 20 test episodes, when rolled up, then teacher, writer, editor and voice lines are shown against the estimate ($0.08, $0.07, $0.03, $0.18).

title: Spend caps and spend mode
story: As an operator, I want a daily spend cap, a per-learner daily cost guard, and `spend_mode` with conserve and halt wired into the pipeline and call configuration, so that a runaway night cannot bankrupt the beta.
acceptance_criteria: Given the cap is reached, when a new vendor call is attempted, then halt refuses non-live calls and conserve switches to the cheaper configuration first.

title: Cost alarms
story: As an operator, I want alarms for kind ceilings, unpriced calls, low cache hit, a session over $1.00, p50 over $0.80 for 7 days and daily spend, so that the stop line is seen the day it is crossed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a session over $1.00, when rolled up, then `session_over_alert` fires with the role breakdown.

title: Call cost and the Haiku-host comparison
story: As an operator, I want per-call cost including LiveKit minutes, the host's cache hit rate, and the 50-call run repeated with a Haiku-class host, so that the cheapest host that passes the governor is known.
acceptance_criteria: Given the comparison, when done, then latency, governor violations and cost per call are in one table for both hosts.

title: Vendor health and the failover drill
story: As an operator, I want `/admin/vendors` with health and a drill that kills the primary voice key for an hour and still ships the night's episodes, so that a vendor outage is survivable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the drill, when run in W4, then every episode ships on the secondary and the report records the time to switch.

title: Weekly cost report and the exit document
story: As an operator, I want a weekly report (cost per session, per role, per vendor, cache hits, outliers, next week's prices) and, by 22 December, the exit document with the measured cost and the costed path to $0.35, so that the beta's gate on cost is a number.
acceptance_criteria: Given the pilot learners' production week, when reported, then measured cost per session is shown beside the $0.66 estimate and each lever to $0.35 has a measured first column.

title: Logging with the scrub corpus and paging
story: As an operator, I want structured JSON logs with a scrubber tested against a corpus of personal data, Sentry scrubbing, uptime checks and `ops.page()` to Slack, so that no log carries learner text and an outage is seen.
acceptance_criteria: Given the `pii_corpus`, when the scrubber test runs, then zero leaks; given a down check, then a page arrives within 5 minutes.

title: Milestone 0 fixtures imported
story: As an engineer, I want `tools/import_m0.py` to write fixtures (learner files, scripts with hand coverage, editor reads, transcripts and tags, 30 clips, facts, similarity pairs), so that every suite has real data from day one.
acceptance_criteria: Given the import, when run, then every fixture listed in the operations design exists with its source clip's consent checked.

title: Eval suites and the eval gate in CI
story: As an operator, I want suites for fitter, law scan, claim gate, recognizers, editor, writer, pipeline, memory, host governor replay, injection and analyst, with `eval-gate` running the mapped suites on prompt or rule changes, so that a prompt change cannot break law 7 unseen.
acceptance_criteria: Given a host prompt change that adds "that's wrong", when CI runs, then the law scan and governor replay fail the build.
priority: P0 (law scan, governor, editor), P1 (the rest)

title: Alert rules for pipeline, client, call, cost, privacy and crisis
story: As an operator, I want `ops/alerts.yaml` with rules for missed drops, fallback rates, degraded editor, voice failover, slow first sound, slow host replies, governor violations, cost lines, privacy misses and crisis activations, so that the twelve things that go wrong page.
acceptance_criteria: Given an episode not ready before drop, when detected, then a page arrives within 5 minutes with the runbook link.

title: Release manifest, feature flags and the freeze
story: As an operator, I want every release to record code, prompt and bible versions, flags to switch features without a deploy, and a freeze from 19 December 12:00, so that a bad prompt can be traced and pulled.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bad episode, when its release is looked up, then the manifest names every prompt version in it; given the `pull` action, then the episode is removed from Today and the feed.

title: Runbooks, on-call and the tabletop
story: As an operator, I want the twelve runbooks, an on-call rota with phone escalation, the 08:30 checklist and one 60-minute tabletop (failover by hand, pull, re-run after-pass, wrong memory), so that the 05:40 drop failure has a known owner.
acceptance_criteria: Given the tabletop, when done before 22 December, then R1 to R4 and R12 were rehearsed and the gaps ticketed.

title: Measures and the admin measures page
story: As an operator, I want the product measures (first sound, pilot time, speech minutes, talk share, worth it, return after gap, false claims, wrong memories, cost) computed daily with readable-from dates, so that the gates can be read on 26 January from the first day's data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the measures page, when opened, then each measure shows its value, its noise and the date it became readable.

title: Review sampling and the review pages
story: As an operator, I want 10 random episodes per learner per month and a sample of calls queued for a person to read, with names tokenized, so that quality is judged by a human every month.
acceptance_criteria: Given the review queue, when a reviewer flags an episode, then the flag feeds the editor suite as a new fixture.

title: The gates page
story: As an operator, I want one page with every beta gate (trial to paid, week-4 active, sessions a week, speech minutes, recording change, renewal, worth it, cost, false claims, wrong memories, per-language quality) with pass, stop and readable-from, so that 26 January is a reading, not a debate.
acceptance_criteria: Given a gate below its stop line, when readable, then it is shown in plain words with the stop value beside it.

title: Synthetic learners and the canary
story: As an operator, I want 3 synthetic learners seeded from pilot files in the build and 50 in the beta, with a weekly canary episode, so that the pipeline is exercised without touching a real learner.
acceptance_criteria: Given the canary fails, when detected, then `canary_failed` pages.

title: Vendor regression and the weekly digest
story: As an operator, I want a weekly digest of measures, cost and incidents, and a quarterly vendor regression run on the fixed fixtures, so that a silent vendor model change is caught.
acceptance_criteria: Given the first regression on 1 January, when a vendor's score drops beyond the threshold, then an incident is opened.

title: Cohort 1 invited on 23 December
story: As an operator, I want the first batch of about 50 invites sent from the waitlist on 23 December, with the pilot learners first, so that the beta starts on the day.
acceptance_criteria: Given the batch, when sent, then redemptions, first sound and first spoken sentence are on the measures page the same day.
depends_on: E06-S02, every P0 story in E01 to E15

title: Weekly cohorts and the 08:30 checklist
story: As an operator, I want a new batch each week and a daily checklist (drops, fallbacks, cost, pages, review queue), so that the beta runs on a rhythm.
acceptance_criteria: Given a week, when it ends, then the digest shows the cohort's trial-to-paid, sessions, speech minutes and cost.

title: External test at week 0 and week 8
story: As an operator, I want 20 to 30 learners to take a recognized test at week 0 and week 8 with the results imported, so that the internal measure is checked against the world.
acceptance_criteria: Given the import page, when results are loaded, then correlation with the internal skill estimates is shown per skill.

title: P1 features shipped during the beta
story: As a learner, I want round two, the finale, the tape, shadowing, Apple and Google sign-in and the dial-in experiment to arrive during the beta, so that the product grows while I use it.
acceptance_criteria: Given each P1 story, when shipped, then it goes out behind a flag with its suite passing and is noted in the digest.

title: First false-claim audit and wrong-memory count
story: As an operator, I want the first false-claim audit on 1 January and the wrong-memory rate read weekly, so that the trust gates are read from real data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the audit, when done, then the rate is on the gates page (target under 5%) with the retractions made.

title: First season finales from 20 January
story: As a learner who started on 23 December, I want my finale on my first session on or after day 28, with the next goal set inside it, so that season one ends with something to hear.
acceptance_criteria: Given the first finales, when produced, then each has at most two measured differences or an honest "too early to say", and the next goal is stored.

title: Per-language quality and the close rule
story: As an operator, I want worth-it and false-claim rates per language, and a rule that closes a language that falls well behind English until fixed, so that opening many languages never means shipping a bad one.
acceptance_criteria: Given a second language open, when its worth-it rate is more than 15 points below English for two weeks, then it closes to new learners.

title: Cost path executed: batch voices and the January prices
story: As an operator, I want batch text-to-speech and the January voice plan executed during the beta, so that cost moves toward $0.35 while the beta runs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the week of 28 December, when the next-week-prices report runs, then the January rises are in it and the measured cost per session is below $0.60.

title: Gate review on 26 January
story: As an operator, I want a one-page reading of every gate against its pass and stop lines, with the failed claim named if any, so that the decision is made on the day.
acceptance_criteria: Given the gates page, when snapshotted on 26 January, then each gate is pass, fail or not readable, and the document names the one change each failure implies.

title: Season two plan (27 January to 23 February)
story: As an operator, I want the first post-beta season planned from the gate review: public prices confirmed, the floor stack migrated piece by piece behind blind tests, the observer tested behind a flag, and the second language opened if it passed, so that the beta's lessons become the launch.
acceptance_criteria: Given the review, when the plan is written, then each item has a gate it depends on and a date.

title: The host answers within about a second
story: As a learner, I want the host to reply within about a second of my turn ending, so that the call feels like a conversation.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the 50 scripted calls, when measured, then reply latency median is under 1.5 s and p95 under 2.5 s, and connect is under 3 s.
Given production, when a day's calls are measured, then `host_reply_p50` over 1.5 s for an hour pages.

title: First sound in under 60 seconds, first sentence in under 5 minutes
acceptance_criteria: Given a first open on a 4G phone, when measured on the pilot learners' re-onboarding, then Salma's voice plays under 60 s, the pilot plays under 45 s after intake, and the learner's first spoken sentence is under 5 minutes.

title: The dropped episode starts in under 2 seconds; on-demand kinds in under 30 seconds
acceptance_criteria: Given a dropped episode, when Play is tapped, then sound starts under 2 s; given a swap, return or sample, then streaming starts under 30 s.

title: The word sheet opens in under 300 ms; the word button answers in under 2 s
The after-session pass finishes within 10 minutes and tomorrow's episode is ready before the drop
acceptance_criteria: Given a session end, when the pass runs, then `session.after_pass.completed` under 10 minutes p99; given the drop time, then 95% of episodes were ready before it, and the batch falls back to on-demand at drop minus 90 minutes.

title: Cost per session under $0.60 in the beta, with a costed path to $0.35
story: As an operator, I want every session's cost measured against the $0.60 budget and the $0.66 estimate, so that the stop line ($1.00 with no plan) is never crossed unseen.
acceptance_criteria:
Given the pilot learners' production week, when rolled up, then the measured cost per session is in the exit document beside the estimate, with the levers to $0.35 each carrying a measured first column.
Given a session over $1.00, when rolled up, then it pages with the role breakdown; given p50 over $0.80 for 7 days, then it pages.
Given no plan may lose money at full use at $0.35, when prices are confirmed, then the 2 and 3 a day plans break even at $0.42 or below.

title: The sample episode costs under $0.05 and a trial under $8
Daily spend is capped and a runaway halts
acceptance_criteria: Given the daily cap, when reached, then non-live vendor calls halt and the on-call is paged; live calls finish.

title: Told, not inferred
acceptance_criteria: Given any brief, when compiled, then only confirmed, quote-backed facts appear; sensitive classes never appear unless the learner raised them; no enrichment or external lookup about a person exists in the codebase (a dependency allow-list test).

title: Deletion and export on the clock
acceptance_criteria:
Voice storage off: call audio deleted within 15 minutes of call end. Revoke: all audio within 24 hours. Export: link within 1 hour. Account deletion: access ends at once, live purge within 24 hours, backups within 30 days. Trial ended unpaid: 90 days of archive access, then one email, then deletion.
Given each window, when `privacy/verify` runs daily, then a missed window pages.

title: No personal data in logs, traces or third parties beyond the register
acceptance_criteria: Given the scrub corpus, when tests run, then zero leaks; Langfuse retention is 30 days with per-user deletion; every vendor in `vendors.yaml` has a DPA or terms and a training opt-out recorded.

title: Every learner's audio under their own key
AI disclosure and the crisis protocol in every live role
acceptance_criteria: Given "are you real?", when asked of any character in any language, then a plain answer; given a crisis keyword, then step-out, quarantine and the resources card.

title: No game furniture can be built
acceptance_criteria: Given a component for a streak, points, level, percentage, chart, leaderboard or confetti, when lint runs, then the build fails; counts are plain text and monotonic.

title: Nothing reads as a correction
acceptance_criteria: Given any generated surface (episode, call, chat, proof, feed note), when the law scan runs, then no string from the corpus ("wrong", "the correct answer", "you should have said", homework phrasing) appears; the host's per-call budgets hold (1 recast per turn, 3 clarifications, 1 nudge).

title: No claim without proof
acceptance_criteria: Given any progress sentence template, when CI greps, then it resolves to a `claims` row; the first false-claim audit on 1 January shows under 5%.

title: Exactly three outbound messages
acceptance_criteria: Given the codebase, when the messaging test runs, then only the drop, the one opt-in gap note and the weekly proof can be sent; no re-engagement job exists.

title: A prompt change cannot ship without its suite
acceptance_criteria: Given a change to a prompt, bible or rule, when CI runs, then `eval-gate` runs the mapped suites and a regression beyond threshold fails the build; the release manifest records every version.

title: Calibration against a person
acceptance_criteria: Classifier precision at least 0.8 on claim-feeding tags; rater agreement about 0.7 quadratic weighted kappa; 150 to 200 double-tagged samples by the end of the beta; a human reads 10 random episodes per learner per month.

title: Coverage and variety measured on every episode
acceptance_criteria: About 95% known words for audio and 98% for text (dial per learner); no format three times in a row; cosine similarity against the last 20 under the threshold set from the pilot's "too alike" pairs.

title: No session is lost to a voice failure
acceptance_criteria: Given a live voice failure, when detected, then the call falls back to voice notes with the same host; given a voice vendor outage, then the secondary carries the same day's production.

title: A missed drop pages within 5 minutes and has a runbook
Production restored from backup once before the beta
Capacity for 50 concurrent learners at the morning peak
acceptance_criteria: Given the drop minute for 250 learners, when load-tested, then media p95 first byte under 500 ms; given 15 concurrent calls, then no degradation in reply latency.

title: Works in the learner's own language, including right-to-left
acceptance_criteria: Given Arabic, Hebrew, Persian or Urdu as the learner's language, when any screen renders, then the bidi snapshot suite passes and logical properties are used throughout (lint).

title: Usable with a screen reader and on a mid-range Android
acceptance_criteria: Lighthouse performance above 85; every control labelled; captions on the call.

title: A language opens only through the gate
acceptance_criteria: Given a language package, when marked shippable, then all five checks passed in the harness and the result page is linked from the release manifest.
